gates.title: Legal terms, early-exit formula and forum
gates.required_evidence: Reviewed CFG-TERMS-B2B-2026-08-17-v1, written counsel opinion on enforceability, entity data and elected forum, plus invoice/settlement wording for the three-cap early-exit formula.
gates.approve_consequence: Approve this terms version for contracting.
gates.reject_consequence: Keep every offer gated; do not activate or publish.

gates.title: Accountant, NFS-e and effective tax treatment
gates.required_evidence: Tax classification (CNAE, Annex/factor R, RBT12, municipal item), invoice test and margin impact. The 6% pricing premise is not a confirmed tax regime.
gates.approve_consequence: Enable approved NFS-e issuance under the validated classification.
gates.reject_consequence: Keep production NFS-e blocked; manual finance hold.

gates.title: Staffed recurring capacity inventory and delivery owner
gates.required_evidence: Published staffed inventory independently declared by the delivery owner, versioned working calendar, complete Work Order WIP, collision policy and model-only hold/release reconciliation. The commercial ceiling of 50 is not staffed inventory.
gates.approve_consequence: Release recurring quantity for holds after other gates allow checkout.
gates.reject_consequence: No recurring checkout; waitlist, Diagnóstico or fit conversation only.

gates.title: Security, environment segregation, secrets, rotation, rollback and Sandbox E2E
gates.required_evidence: Separated Sandbox/production, least privilege, secret rotation, Sandbox E2E, monitoring, runbook and rollback. Production API key and production webhook remain unapproved.
gates.approve_consequence: Permit controlled production configuration after a separate finance/operator action.
gates.reject_consequence: Sandbox-only; no production checkout or webhook.

gates.title: Brand, commercial and legal final publication
gates.required_evidence: Approved registry, public copy, scope, FAQ, terms, accessibility and SEO. Catalog presence is not publication.

gates.title: Finance/operator approval for each real money mutation
gates.required_evidence: Customer, contract, capacity, terms and payment evidence for a single charge, refund or cancellation.
gates.approve_consequence: Perform one approved provider action with audit evidence.

gates.title: Change to the Extra historical exception
gates.required_evidence: Explicit addendum and non-MFC review. The historical R$ 10.000/month x 6 condition is not a public offer, coupon or equalization baseline.
gates.approve_consequence: Apply a documented private exception change.
gates.reject_consequence: Preserve the current private contract; do not publish or equalize.
